mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT su.id, su.username, su.real_name AS realName FROM sys_user su WHERE su.deleted = 0 ORDER BY su.id

SELECT sur.user_id AS userId, sr.id AS roleId, sr.code AS roleCode, sr.name AS roleName FROM sys_user_role sur JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.id = sur.role_id WHERE sur.user_id IN #{userId} ORDER BY sur.user_id, sr.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
